faults.title: Fragile interior trim
faults.description: Interior pieces on the first-generation Fiat 500 can crack or break with use. Inspect handles, switches and trim fittings and repair loose parts before they interfere with normal operation.

faults.title: Electric power-steering recall
faults.description: A 2017 recall addressed electric power-steering problems on some Fiat 500s. Check the car's recall history by VIN and confirm any required remedial work was completed.
